name: Maestro
description: MIDI auto-player for the band instrument — playlists, group sync and a local sound preview.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Performing a song in-world with the Library, Auto-Player and Preview windows open.
Auto-Player — playlist, queue and playback controls.
Library — browse your MIDI folder and add songs to the queue.
Local Preview — audition through the real in-game instrument sounds.
Settings — per-song controls, Network Sync and Ensemble options.

added: New experimental setting, "Workaround server tone relay bug" (off by default): when on, other players who also use Stellar can hear your guitar and bass Overdrive and Distortion — tones the game normally doesn't carry to them.
New "Tone lead" control in Network Settings: raise it if a tone change reaches your listeners a note late.
fixed: The Restrike gap's reset button now restores its default value instead of switching it off.
